observations: A wide-brimmed hat with camouflage-like green, black, and grey patches sits atop the figure; a tight zigzag line in yellow-orange runs along its lower brim edge.
Two large circular eye forms with concentric ring marks dominate the face center; a third circular form in red and orange occupies the lower face, its function as a specific feature unclear.
The lower half breaks into dense overlapping vertical strokes and loops in red, yellow, blue, and black against the olive-green ground, contrasting with the more contained forms of the head above.
reading: The figure holds the center with a hat that pulls the eye upward, while the face is built from rings and concentric marks that feel watchful rather than open. Below, the body dissolves into a tangle of strokes that reads as noise or crowd. That split—contained head, fractured lower field—gives the image a sense of something holding at the top while coming apart beneath.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #275 and nnxyz nnotb #277 share a figure-on-flat-ground format. This work stands apart by pushing dense background marks into the lower foreground, making the surrounding space feel more pressured than in either neighbor.

connections.reason: Both works center a face with circular eye forms and surround it with dense multi-color looping marks that compete with the figure, though rawblocks #55 fills the entire field while #276 keeps the upper figure more isolated.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the dense mark-making at the bottom begin to overlap the figure's outline, and what does that boundary look like?
ambiguities: The red-orange circular form in the lower face occupies the nose-mouth zone but its function as a specific facial feature cannot be confirmed from the image alone.
